mapper.select: SELECT pda.STATENO, pda.DISCARD_STATUS, std.DOCUMENT_ID, std.EHARS_IMPORT_DATE, std.FNAME , std.MNAME , std.LNAME , std.SSN , std.BIRTH_SEX , std.DOB_TEXT , std.STATE_RES , std.MONTH_DEATH, std.DAY_DEATH, std.YEAR_DEATH, std.RECEIVED_DATE , std.UNIQ_NO , raw1.NDIFILE_CAT , std.NDI_DOD , std.DEATH_CERT , std.STATE_DEATH , std.ICD_CODE , std.HIVCAUSE , std.NIF1 , std.NIF10 , std.NIF11 , std.NIF12 , std.NIF13 , std.NIF14 , std.NIF15 , std.NIF16 , std.NIF17 , std.NIF18 , std.NIF19 , std.NIF2 , std.NIF20 , std.NIF3 , std.NIF4 , std.NIF5 , std.NIF6 , std.NIF7 , std.NIF8 , std.NIF9 , std.COD1 , std.COD10 , std.COD11 , std.COD12 , std.COD13 , std.COD14 , std.COD15 , std.COD16 , std.COD17 , std.COD18 , std.COD19 , std.COD2 , std.COD20 , std.COD3 , std.COD4 , std.COD5 , std.COD6 , std.COD7 , std.COD8 , std.COD9 , std.NYC_SHIP_DATE ,D.PARENT_DOCUMENT_ID FROM RAW_NDI_DOC raw1 INNER JOIN STD_NDI_DOC std ON (std.document_id = raw1.document_id and raw1.DOCUMENT_ID=#{documentId}) INNER JOIN document_locator D ON raw1.document_id=d.document_id LEFT OUTER JOIN person_doc_association pda ON (raw1.document_id = pda.document_id AND pda.dissassociation_date IS NULL)
